prompt:
CHARACTER CONCEPT SHEET - reference only, not a game asset. Art direction for a dark modern 2D pixel-art roguelike action game (top-down three-quarter view) set in a grim Renaissance-era early-gunpowder world (pikes, matchlock muskets, mud, oak barrels, timber-and-plaster towns). Mood: bleak and weary with a dry, sly dark humor. Rendering: crisp high-detail modern pixel art at large scale, smooth and detailed like contemporary hand-animated pixel action games, cel shading with clear volume, dark 1-pixel outlines, light from the upper left. Every figure full body on a flat plain dark slate-gray background with a soft floor shadow, evenly spaced with clear gaps, no overlap, no scenery. Palette: charcoal and ash grays, warm umber wood and leather, dirty pale linen, and a warm amber/ember accent (#8b4d22, #d67a11, #e8b858, #faeec0) used for liquor, glowing eyes and fire. No saturated blue, green, purple or red; no pink skin. No text, no letters, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no watermark, no frame.

Subject: the first-floor boss, "the Brewmaster, Full-Drunk" - the ruler of a liquor empire, completely, gloriously drunk. A huge heavy man about two and a half times as tall and three times as wide as a normal man (show a small plain dark human silhouette next to him for scale, reaching only his belly). Enormous round belly bursting out of a stained, half-open pale doublet; a dark fur-trimmed mantle slipping off one shoulder; a small dented crown sliding off a sweaty bald head; ragged beard; heavy flushed amber-brown face with half-closed glowing amber eyes and a loose, dangerous grin. A brewer's leather apron with a tap and ladle hanging at the belt, thick legs in tall boots, swaying unbalanced stance. His signature prop is one GIANT drinking vessel - a heavy pewter tankard-goblet the size of a small bucket with a brass rim, overflowing with amber liquor.

Layout in two rows, no duplicates. Top row: front view, side view facing right, back view (mantle and bald head with crown). Bottom row, action poses: (a) tipping the giant goblet up to his mouth and gulping, liquor pouring down his beard and belly; (b) a staggering curved drunken charge, leaning far forward, belly first; (c) flat on his back after tripping, legs in the air; (d) kicking a big oak barrel so it rolls away; (e) hurling a burning torch overhand.
